title: Oracle Midday Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds at 64,548 dollars with a slim 0.2 percent gain as fear dominates the tape at a 28 reading. US morning action delivered no breakout, just sideways drift.

Hashrate prints 1,036 EH/s, reinforcing miner commitment despite the sentiment. Mempool backlog sits at 97,880 transactions yet the fastest fee remains only 2 sat per vbyte, pointing to congestion without fee pressure. Block height now 958,763.

Network security stays elevated while spot traders wait for direction.
